description: How far a terminal agent may take the current task. The mode is scoped by the PM per task or task bundle. Default is mode.review_only. A mode never overrides a boundary or an actor capability.

entries.summary: Read, analyze, and report. No file edits, no git writes, no GitHub writes.
Scoped local edits and validation on a work branch. No commit, no push, no PR, no GitHub mutation.
Scoped edits, validation, commit, and push to the scoped work branch. No PR creation and no other GitHub mutation.
Scoped edits, validation, commit, push, and draft PR creation for the scoped issue. Merge and closure stay with the PM.

Internal-only execution of target-owned deployment commands for one approved environment, local or staging only. Runs only commands documented as target-owned in the target's Project-specific notes; never edits repo files, commits, pushes, opens PRs, invents commands, exposes or requests secrets, runs broad environment/config dumps, or mutates secret stores. Production execution stays with the Human PM by default and is never run by a terminal agent under this mode.

approval_note: An explicit PM decision or approval is controlling evidence for the point decided. A PM-approved scoped route prompt, or manual PM execution of an already scoped command bundle, is approval evidence for that exact scope. Do not re-request authorization, return status.needs_pm_decision, or return status.blocked for agent disagreement alone. Report disagreement as risk or accepted exception unless a named boundary or gate is hit, separate exact approval is required for a different write action, or new material evidence changes scope, target, actor, write type, risk, feasibility, or evidence sufficiency.
